subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Nature teach us / to maintain / a balance / in life.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Nature teach us"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Nature is referred to as 3rd person singular in the sentence.
 
• English grammar rules state that every 3rd person singular is followed by the verb of 's' or 'es'.
 
 
• Example - ***Trust takes time**.*
 
 
 
• The correct sentence is, **Nature teaches us / to maintain / a balance / in life**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
